reason: The one-shot evaluation of the strict blind holdout (1964 cases across 8 suites, built with zero runtime exposure and frozen at T21R2.16) met the retrieval, grounded-accuracy, citation-suite, temporal and conflict-detection floors with every zero-tolerance counter zero, but failed 6 preregistered floors: abstention precision 0.7935 (floor 0.98), injection containment 0.9569 (floor 1.0), citation-id spoof rejection 0.92 (floor 1.0), and the contract-level citation resolvability/validity/precision floors (0.9548 vs 1.0/1.0/0.99). All 66 incorrect rows reconcile exactly to a single failure mode - over-abstention on 64 gold-ANSWER rows - plus 2 citation-spoof misses. The dominant mechanism is a frozen-runtime defect: detect_conflicts flags a conflict whenever two evidence items share fact_entity|fact_attribute but have different text_spans, without comparing fact_value, so contract-mandated restated-fact pairs (identical value, different wording) return CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE. Neither T21 nor T21R ever exercised same-attribute restatements; the T21R2 blind holdout is the first and it falsifies the T21R promotion evidence's generalization.
decision_basis: Blind construction proven: world/corpus/suites built with no runtime execution against any holdout datum (firewall tests), uniqueness audit verdict UNIQUE against BOTH T21 and T21R on every frozen identity dimension, static gold audit PASS 0 failures.
Ordering proven: runtime freeze (T21R2.0) and evaluator freeze (T21R2.1) predate all holdout data; evaluator frozen before holdout; HOLDOUT_FROZEN at T21R2.16 before any runtime exposure.
official_runtime_exposures = 1 (evaluation_run_ledger.json); no repair, no rerun, no gold or scoring change after the evaluation.

Floors failed on the fresh holdout - CONFIRM is impossible; the failure classification (failure_analysis.json) attributes every failing floor to frozen-runtime behavior on valid gold, not to an evaluator bug (evaluator validity VERDICT: VALID; post-freeze evaluator bug policy NOT triggered) or an infrastructure failure.

Per-category accuracy floors, retrieval floors, temporal floors, conflict detection and false-resolution floors, suite minimums, and all 20 zero-tolerance counters PASS - the capability is real but not at the preregistered promotion bar.
The T21R CONFIRM was based on a holdout that was runtime-exposed pre-freeze; T21R2's independent holdout supersedes it as promotion evidence and does not reproduce the promotion bar.

Per the mission rule, the runtime was never modified during construction or evaluation; the demotion below is the recorded OUTCOME action, applied after the evaluation, to executive/skills.py only (src/sciencemath/knowledge remains byte-identical to the canonical base).
